items.key_claim: 苹果将iPhone Duo订单上调30%，并在iPhone 18 Pro系列总订单不变的情况下将订单向Pro Max倾斜，更高价值产品占比提升利好苹果产业链盈利。

key_claim_i18n.en: Apple raised iPhone Duo orders by 30% and shifted the unchanged total iPhone 18 Pro-series order volume toward the Pro Max, with a richer mix of higher-value devices benefiting supply-chain earnings.
key_claim_i18n.zh: 苹果将iPhone Duo订单上调30%，并在iPhone 18 Pro系列总订单不变的情况下将订单向Pro Max倾斜，更高价值产品占比提升利好苹果产业链盈利。

items.risk: 供应链订单信息尚未得到苹果官方确认，且Duo总订单仍低于1,000万部；订单调整也未必等同于最终销量。

risk_i18n.en: The supply-chain order data has not been officially confirmed by Apple, Duo orders remain below 10 million units, and order adjustments may not translate into final sales.
risk_i18n.zh: 供应链订单信息尚未得到苹果官方确认，且Duo总订单仍低于1,000万部；订单调整也未必等同于最终销量。

items.summary: AAPL秋季2026年产品线订单出现结构性调整：iPhone Duo订单增加30%，但总量仍低于1,000万部；iPhone 18 Pro订单下调10%至15%，Pro Max订单上调10%至15%，Pro系列总订单不变。订单向价格更高的Pro Max倾斜，意味着产品组合改善，并可能提振苹果供应链盈利。

summary_i18n.en: AAPL's fall 2026 lineup is undergoing a structural order adjustment: iPhone Duo orders rose 30% but remain below 10 million units, while iPhone 18 Pro orders fell 10%–15% and Pro Max orders increased 10%–15%, leaving total Pro-series orders unchanged. The shift toward the higher-priced Pro Max improves the product mix and could boost earnings across Apple's supply chain.
summary_i18n.zh: AAPL秋季2026年产品线订单出现结构性调整：iPhone Duo订单增加30%，但总量仍低于1,000万部；iPhone 18 Pro订单下调10%至15%，Pro Max订单上调10%至15%，Pro系列总订单不变。订单向价格更高的Pro Max倾斜，意味着产品组合改善，并可能提振苹果供应链盈利。

items.key_claim: RTX 5090据称已停产，GB202芯片后续将仅供应RTX Pro产品线，显示NVDA正把旗舰GPU资源从消费级市场转向更高价值的专业级产品。

key_claim_i18n.en: The RTX 5090 is reportedly discontinued, with future GB202 supply reserved exclusively for the RTX Pro lineup, indicating that NVDA is shifting flagship GPU resources from consumer products toward higher-value professional offerings.
key_claim_i18n.zh: RTX 5090据称已停产，GB202芯片后续将仅供应RTX Pro产品线，显示NVDA正把旗舰GPU资源从消费级市场转向更高价值的专业级产品。

items.risk: 停产及GB202独家供应RTX Pro的消息缺乏公司官方确认，后续产能分配仍可能变化；退出旗舰消费市场也可能损害GeForce生态与消费者需求。

risk_i18n.en: The reported discontinuation and exclusive allocation of GB202 to RTX Pro lack official company confirmation, and capacity plans could change; withdrawing from the flagship consumer segment could also hurt the GeForce ecosystem and consumer demand.
risk_i18n.zh: 停产及GB202独家供应RTX Pro的消息缺乏公司官方确认，后续产能分配仍可能变化；退出旗舰消费市场也可能损害GeForce生态与消费者需求。

items.summary: NVDA的RTX 5090据称已停产，GB202芯片将不再用于5090，而是独家供应RTX Pro产品线。此举可能改善高端专业GPU的供给和产品组合，但会压缩旗舰消费级显卡供应，因此对NVDA的影响偏混合。

summary_i18n.en: NVDA's RTX 5090 is reportedly discontinued, and the GB202 chip will no longer be used for the 5090 but supplied exclusively to the RTX Pro lineup. This could improve supply and product mix for high-end professional GPUs while constraining flagship consumer graphics-card availability, making the overall impact on NVDA mixed.
summary_i18n.zh: NVDA的RTX 5090据称已停产，GB202芯片将不再用于5090，而是独家供应RTX Pro产品线。此举可能改善高端专业GPU的供给和产品组合，但会压缩旗舰消费级显卡供应，因此对NVDA的影响偏混合。

items.key_claim: 中国AI短剧应用即使内容质量不高，仍可凭借强烈的即时娱乐和多巴胺反馈登上App Store榜单并促使用户付费。

key_claim_i18n.en: Chinese AI short-drama apps can top App Store charts and persuade users to pay through strong instant-entertainment and dopamine-driven engagement, even when content quality is poor.
key_claim_i18n.zh: 中国AI短剧应用即使内容质量不高，仍可凭借强烈的即时娱乐和多巴胺反馈登上App Store榜单并促使用户付费。

items.risk: 榜单排名和冲动付费可能缺乏持续性，低质量内容可能造成高流失率，并面临内容监管、获客成本和同质化竞争压力。

risk_i18n.en: Chart rankings and impulse spending may not be sustainable; low-quality content could drive high churn and face regulatory, customer-acquisition-cost, and commoditization pressures.
risk_i18n.zh: 榜单排名和冲动付费可能缺乏持续性，低质量内容可能造成高流失率，并面临内容监管、获客成本和同质化竞争压力。

items.summary: 中国AI短剧应用持续占据App Store榜单前列，表明用户付费不完全取决于内容品质。只要产品能提供足够强的即时刺激和娱乐反馈，AI短剧仍可能形成有效的用户增长与变现模式。

summary_i18n.en: Chinese AI short-drama apps continue to rank near the top of the App Store, suggesting that user spending does not depend solely on content quality. If these products deliver sufficiently strong instant stimulation and entertainment, AI short dramas may still support effective user growth and monetization.
summary_i18n.zh: 中国AI短剧应用持续占据App Store榜单前列，表明用户付费不完全取决于内容品质。只要产品能提供足够强的即时刺激和娱乐反馈，AI短剧仍可能形成有效的用户增长与变现模式。

items.key_claim: NFLX若不尽快大举投资AI视频生成，将面临采用中国视频生成模型制作的AI短剧对其用户注意力和竞争地位的严重侵蚀。

key_claim_i18n.en: If NFLX does not invest heavily in AI video generation soon, AI short-form dramas created with Chinese video models could severely erode its audience attention and competitive position.
key_claim_i18n.zh: NFLX若不尽快大举投资AI视频生成，将面临采用中国视频生成模型制作的AI短剧对其用户注意力和竞争地位的严重侵蚀。

items.risk: AI短剧能否长期替代高质量长视频内容尚未得到验证，Netflix大规模采用生成式视频也可能面临版权、质量控制、品牌和监管风险。

risk_i18n.en: It remains unproven whether AI short-form dramas can sustainably substitute for high-quality long-form content, while large-scale adoption of generative video by Netflix could create copyright, quality-control, brand, and regulatory risks.
risk_i18n.zh: AI短剧能否长期替代高质量长视频内容尚未得到验证，Netflix大规模采用生成式视频也可能面临版权、质量控制、品牌和监管风险。

items.summary: NFLX需要尽快大规模投入AI视频生成，否则可能被基于中国视频生成模型的AI短剧抢夺用户时长与付费需求。该判断对Netflix现有内容生产模式和长期竞争力偏空，同时将AI视频能力视为必须加速布局的防御性投资。

summary_i18n.en: NFLX needs to invest aggressively in AI video generation or risk losing viewing time and paid demand to AI short-form dramas built with Chinese video models. This is bearish for Netflix's existing content-production model and long-term competitiveness, while framing AI video capabilities as an urgent defensive investment.
summary_i18n.zh: NFLX需要尽快大规模投入AI视频生成，否则可能被基于中国视频生成模型的AI短剧抢夺用户时长与付费需求。该判断对Netflix现有内容生产模式和长期竞争力偏空，同时将AI视频能力视为必须加速布局的防御性投资。

key_claim_i18n.en: AEHR would be more attractive to buy only after a further price decline makes its valuation cheaper.
key_claim_i18n.zh: AEHR只有在价格进一步回落、估值更便宜后才更值得买入。

risk_i18n.en: AEHR may still be overvalued, and entering too early could expose investors to further downside.
risk_i18n.zh: AEHR当前估值仍可能偏高，过早入场可能承受进一步下跌。

items.summary: AEHR可能存在资金与机构关注，但更合适的策略是等待价格进一步回落后再买，而不是在当前估值下追高。

summary_i18n.en: AEHR may be attracting capital and institutional attention, but the preferable strategy is to wait for a further pullback rather than chase it at the current valuation.
summary_i18n.zh: AEHR可能存在资金与机构关注，但更合适的策略是等待价格进一步回落后再买，而不是在当前估值下追高。

items.key_claim: SNPS若想守住中国市场份额，几乎必须与中国AI实验室合作，因为本土EDA厂商正通过与国内AI机构结盟侵蚀SNPS和CDNS的市场地位。

key_claim_i18n.en: SNPS has little choice but to collaborate with Chinese AI labs if it wants to defend its China market share, as domestic EDA vendors are partnering with local AI institutions to erode the positions of SNPS and CDNS.
key_claim_i18n.zh: SNPS若想守住中国市场份额，几乎必须与中国AI实验室合作，因为本土EDA厂商正通过与国内AI机构结盟侵蚀SNPS和CDNS的市场地位。

items.risk: 与中国AI实验室合作可能受到美国出口管制、技术转移和合规限制；若合作受阻，本土EDA替代速度可能进一步加快。

risk_i18n.en: Collaboration with Chinese AI labs could be constrained by U.S. export controls, technology-transfer concerns, and compliance requirements; if cooperation is blocked, domestic EDA substitution may accelerate further.
risk_i18n.zh: 与中国AI实验室合作可能受到美国出口管制、技术转移和合规限制；若合作受阻，本土EDA替代速度可能进一步加快。

items.summary: 中国本土EDA公司正积极与国内AI实验室合作，以削弱SNPS和CDNS在中国的市场份额。SNPS要维持竞争力可能需要采取类似合作策略，但出口管制与合规限制会增加执行难度，整体反映两家美国EDA龙头在中国面临上升的国产替代压力。

summary_i18n.en: Chinese EDA companies are actively partnering with domestic AI labs to weaken the China market share of SNPS and CDNS. SNPS may need to pursue similar partnerships to remain competitive, but export controls and compliance restrictions would complicate execution, highlighting rising domestic-substitution pressure on both U.S. EDA leaders.
summary_i18n.zh: 中国本土EDA公司正积极与国内AI实验室合作，以削弱SNPS和CDNS在中国的市场份额。SNPS要维持竞争力可能需要采取类似合作策略，但出口管制与合规限制会增加执行难度，整体反映两家美国EDA龙头在中国面临上升的国产替代压力。

items.key_claim: AI算力瓶颈正从加速器转向光学、互连和内存，长期供不应求可能推动LITE、COHR、MRVL及相关交换机供应链进入结构性增长周期。 重点标的: $LITE, $MRVL, $NOK, $NVDA, $COHR, $AMD

key_claim_i18n.en: AI compute bottlenecks are shifting from accelerators to optics, interconnects, and memory, with prolonged shortages potentially driving a structural growth cycle for LITE, COHR, MRVL, and the related switch supply chain. Key tickers: $LITE, $MRVL, $NOK, $NVDA, $COHR, $AMD
key_claim_i18n.zh: AI算力瓶颈正从加速器转向光学、互连和内存，长期供不应求可能推动LITE、COHR、MRVL及相关交换机供应链进入结构性增长周期。 重点标的: $LITE, $MRVL, $NOK, $NVDA, $COHR, $AMD

items.risk: 远期需求、2030年TAM及定制芯片渗透率主要依赖管理层和行业预测；若新增产能集中释放、AI资本开支放缓或技术路线变化，当前短缺和高增长预期可能快速逆转。

risk_i18n.en: Long-term demand, the 2030 TAM, and custom-chip penetration depend heavily on management and industry forecasts; a wave of new capacity, slower AI capital spending, or a technology shift could quickly reverse current shortage and growth expectations.
risk_i18n.zh: 远期需求、2030年TAM及定制芯片渗透率主要依赖管理层和行业预测；若新增产能集中释放、AI资本开支放缓或技术路线变化，当前短缺和高增长预期可能快速逆转。

items.summary: LITE产能据称已售罄至2029年初，部分产品明年约70%的需求无法满足，客户甚至开始锁定2030年订单；MRVL则称连接产品已领先于定制芯片，其2030年TAM上调至约4000亿美元、为此前估计的4倍，NOK也正借此构建转型逻辑。NVDA分别向LITE、COHR和MRVL投入20亿美元以锁定激光与互连供应，AMD仍将扩张但可能尚未 확보足够产能；预计2028年后约50%的AI服务器将采用定制ASIC，进一步拉动交换机和光学器件需求，使相关高质量标的具备显著上涨潜力。 重点标的: $LITE, $MRVL, $NOK, $NVDA, $COHR, $AMD

summary_i18n.en: LITE is reportedly sold out through early 2029, with roughly 70% of next year's demand for some products going unmet and customers already securing 2030 orders; MRVL says connectivity has moved ahead of custom silicon and raised its 2030 TAM to about $400 billion, four times its previous estimate, while NOK is using the same trend to support a turnaround narrative. NVDA has invested $2 billion each in LITE, COHR, and MRVL to secure laser and interconnect supply, while AMD continues to scale but may not yet have secured enough capacity; with custom ASICs expected to represent about 50% of AI server deployments beyond 2028, demand for switches and optical components could rise further and create substantial upside for high-quality suppliers. Key tickers: $LITE, $MRVL, $NOK, $NVDA, $COHR, $AMD

items.key_claim: ASTS难以与SpaceX竞争，放量加速下跌显示其前景显著恶化。

key_claim_i18n.en: ASTS is unlikely to compete effectively with SpaceX, while its accelerating high-volume decline signals a sharply deteriorating outlook.
key_claim_i18n.zh: ASTS难以与SpaceX竞争，放量加速下跌显示其前景显著恶化。

items.risk: 若ASTS在技术、商业合作或监管审批方面取得突破，或SpaceX未能垄断相关市场，极度看空判断可能失效。

risk_i18n.en: The highly bearish thesis could fail if ASTS achieves breakthroughs in technology, commercial partnerships, or regulatory approvals, or if SpaceX does not dominate the relevant market.
risk_i18n.zh: 若ASTS在技术、商业合作或监管审批方面取得突破，或SpaceX未能垄断相关市场，极度看空判断可能失效。

items.summary: ASTS出现放量加速下跌，走势被视为明显转弱。SpaceX被判断为行业主导者并将挤压或淘汰竞争对手，因此ASTS被视为缺乏有效竞争能力、前景极度悲观。

key_claim_i18n.zh: AEHR在股价高于100时估值过高，不适合重仓，随后大幅下跌验证了避免追高的必要性。

items.risk: 即使已经大幅回落，AEHR仍可能因估值压缩而继续下跌。

risk_i18n.en: Even after a substantial decline, AEHR could fall further as its valuation continues to compress.
risk_i18n.zh: 即使已经大幅回落，AEHR仍可能因估值压缩而继续下跌。

items.summary: AEHR股价高于100时已经错过最佳买点，且估值很高，因此不应重仓或盲目追高；此后股价已经出现明显下跌。

summary_i18n.en: When AEHR traded above 100, the optimal entry point had already passed and its valuation was too high to warrant a large position or momentum chasing; the stock has since declined substantially.
summary_i18n.zh: AEHR股价高于100时已经错过最佳买点，且估值很高，因此不应重仓或盲目追高；此后股价已经出现明显下跌。

items.key_claim: COHR有望从当前价位翻倍，按2028财年约15美元EPS和40倍市盈率估值，目标价可达600美元。 重点标的: $COHR, $NVDA, $MSFT, $GOOGL, $AMZN, $META

key_claim_i18n.en: COHR could double from its current level and reach $600 based on approximately $15 in FY2028 EPS and a 40x earnings multiple. Key tickers: $COHR, $NVDA, $MSFT, $GOOGL, $AMZN, $META
key_claim_i18n.zh: COHR有望从当前价位翻倍，按2028财年约15美元EPS和40倍市盈率估值，目标价可达600美元。 重点标的: $COHR, $NVDA, $MSFT, $GOOGL, $AMZN, $META

summary_i18n.en: The sharp selloff in $SHAZ has been attributed to the failed Firmus IPO, changes to Project Southgate, and concerns about OpenAI ARR and the macro environment, but Firmus mainly experienced a delayed private-market valuation reset after listed peers such as $IREN, $CIFR, and $WULF had already been repriced. Southgate's shift away from the original CDC/Firmus structure—which envisioned up to 1.6 GW but deployed only about 42 MW—toward Firmus controlling more of its own infrastructure does not imply that Australian AI demand has disappeared. Reduced Firmus competition for third-party colocation capacity could improve $SHAZ's bargaining power in Australia's data-center ecosystem; with $8.8 billion of contracted TCV, more than 68,000 NVIDIA GPUs targeted by mid-2027, roughly $1.86 billion in cash, and an NVIDIA partnership, the position was tripled, although execution and macro risks remain real and entrants such as $NBIS could still compete for the capacity. items.summary: 市场尚未充分计价光通信短缺的二阶影响：$LITE产能已基本售罄，部分原因是$NVDA锁定Greensboro产能，迫使$AMD和超大规模云厂商寻找其他供应来源。$SIVE计划上线超过1亿只CW DFB激光器产能，约相当于TrendForce所估全球6.08亿只EML/CW激光器现有产能的六分之一，且尚未计入其拟按2:1比例利用的合作晶圆厂；$AAOI明年也将增加足以生产40万只ELSFP及每月4.71亿美元收发器的产能。在光器件成为关键瓶颈、客户供应商数量由过去2至3家扩大至5至7家的背景下，只要产品有效且能够规模化，新增产能获得供应链认证的概率较高。

summary_i18n.en: The market has yet to fully price in the second-order effects of optical communications shortages: $LITE is essentially sold out, partly because $NVDA has secured Greensboro capacity, forcing $AMD and hyperscalers to seek alternative sources of supply. $SIVE plans to bring more than 100 million CW DFB lasers of capacity online—about one-sixth of TrendForce's estimated 608 million units of existing global EML/CW laser capacity—excluding partner foundries it intends to utilize at a 2:1 ratio; $AAOI also expects to add enough capacity next year to produce 400,000 ELSFP units and $471 million of transceivers per month. With optical components becoming a major bottleneck and customers expanding their supplier rosters from two or three vendors to five to seven, new capacity has a strong chance of qualifying for supply chains if the products work and can scale.

risk_i18n.en: The near-term thesis could break if experimental budgets stop growing, AI-generated designs fail to produce useful wet-lab results, or capacity expands too quickly. The key long-term risk is that AI-designed drugs fail in Phase II/III at rates similar to conventional drugs.

items.summary: AI降低假设生成成本并增加候选设计数量，使瓶颈沿“AI模型→设计→DNA/蛋白→检测→临床前产能”向下游移动，利好TWST、GenScript、ILMN、TXG、实验室自动化厂商及CRO；湿实验室也将从制造药物转向持续生产模型训练数据。TWST预计FY26的AI药物发现订单增长达到三位数百分比，FY27再实现三位数增长；GenScript的AIDD业务在1H26同比翻倍，渠道信息显示其处理量约为每日8,000个设计，并可能在2026年底达到约16,000个，动物试验与灵长类资源可能成为下一瓶颈。潜在需求池包括全球每年3,000亿至4,000亿美元的医药研发支出，2026至2027年AI设计药物进入人体试验、2028至2030年临床结果披露是关键催化，但Phase II/III成功率将决定长期逻辑。 重点标的: $TWST, $ILMN, $TXG

summary_i18n.en: AI is lowering the cost of hypothesis generation and increasing the number of candidate designs, shifting the bottleneck downstream through the chain of AI models, designs, DNA/protein production, assays and preclinical capacity. This benefits TWST, GenScript, ILMN, TXG, lab-automation vendors and CROs, while turning wet labs into continuous producers of model-training data. TWST expects triple-digit percentage growth in AI drug-discovery orders in FY26 and another year of triple-digit growth in FY27; GenScript's AIDD business doubled year over year in 1H26, while channel checks indicate throughput of roughly 8,000 designs per day with a path to about 16,000 by year-end 2026, potentially making animal testing and primate supply the next bottlenecks. The potential spending pool includes $300–400 billion in annual global pharmaceutical R&D, with AI-designed drugs entering human trials in 2026–2027 and clinical readouts in 2028–2030 serving as key catalysts, although Phase II/III success rates will ultimately determine the durability of the thesis. Key tickers: $TWST, $ILMN, $TXG

items.summary: AI和算力对原始、低效的医药研发数据整理及新药发现具有革命性意义，也可能推动TWST等上游实验服务需求。但药物最终仍须经过动物实验、患者招募和逐期临床审批；美国一期临床毒性测试约需1.5年，这部分难以靠增加算力提速。

summary_i18n.en: AI and compute can be transformative for organizing inefficient pharmaceutical R&D data and accelerating drug discovery, potentially supporting demand for upstream experimental-service providers such as TWST. However, drugs must still pass animal studies, patient recruitment and successive clinical approvals; Phase I toxicity testing in the U.S. takes about 1.5 years and cannot be materially accelerated merely by adding compute.

key_claim_i18n.zh: 共和党在中期选举中失利几乎不可避免，除非未来几天与伊朗达成实质性协议并及时改善供应链。

items.risk: 若伊朗协议或停火迅速落地并显著缓解供应链及生活成本压力，共和党丢失一院或两院的判断可能被逆转。

risk_i18n.en: If an Iran agreement or ceasefire is reached quickly and materially eases supply-chain and cost-of-living pressures, the expectation that Republicans will lose one or both chambers could be overturned.

items.summary: 共和党在中期选举中失利被视为几乎必然，悬念仅在于是否同时失去参众两院。对Trump而言，只有未来几天与伊朗达成实质性协议，供应链才可能在中期选举前改善；政策选择是在中东妥协以争取保住一院，还是放弃短期选举收益并布局两年后的更彻底解决方案。

summary_i18n.en: A Republican setback in the midterm elections is viewed as nearly inevitable, with the main question being whether the party loses both chambers of Congress. For Trump, only a substantive agreement with Iran within the next few days might allow supply chains to improve before the midterms; the policy choice is between compromising in the Middle East to try to retain one chamber or sacrificing near-term electoral gains to pursue a more comprehensive solution two years later.

items.key_claim: AI大幅降低药物设计成本并增加候选数量，产业瓶颈正从计算与假设生成转向DNA、蛋白、检测、测序、自动化和临床前验证，利好$TWST、$ILMN、$TXG及GenScript等上游工具与服务商。

key_claim_i18n.en: AI is sharply reducing drug-design costs and increasing candidate volumes, shifting the industry bottleneck from computation and hypothesis generation toward DNA, proteins, assays, sequencing, automation and preclinical validation, benefiting upstream tool and service providers such as $TWST, $ILMN, $TXG and GenScript.
key_claim_i18n.zh: AI大幅降低药物设计成本并增加候选数量，产业瓶颈正从计算与假设生成转向DNA、蛋白、检测、测序、自动化和临床前验证，利好$TWST、$ILMN、$TXG及GenScript等上游工具与服务商。

items.risk: 主要风险是实验预算停止增长、AI设计无法转化为有效的湿实验命中、供应能力扩张过快，以及AI药物在II/III期临床试验中的失败率并未优于传统药物。

risk_i18n.en: Key risks are stagnating experimental budgets, AI-generated designs failing to produce useful wet-lab hits, capacity expanding too quickly, and AI-designed drugs showing no improvement over conventional drugs in Phase II/III failure rates.
risk_i18n.zh: 主要风险是实验预算停止增长、AI设计无法转化为有效的湿实验命中、供应能力扩张过快，以及AI药物在II/III期临床试验中的失败率并未优于传统药物。

items.summary: AI药物发现正在形成类似半导体“GPU→HBM→网络→电力与冷却”的瓶颈交易，需求沿“AI模型→设计→DNA/蛋白→检测→临床前产能”向下游传导，$TWST、$ILMN、$TXG、GenScript、实验室自动化厂商和CRO有望受益。$TWST预计FY26的AI药物发现订单实现三位数百分比增长，FY27再度实现三位数增长；GenScript的AIDD业务在2026年上半年同比翻倍，渠道检查显示其处理能力约为每日8,000个设计，并可能在2026年底达到约16,000个。2026至2027年AI原生项目进入人体试验及IND申报准备可能成为催化，动物实验与CRO产能或成为下一瓶颈，而2028至2030年的II期及后续临床结果将决定长期逻辑能否成立。

summary_i18n.en: AI drug discovery is developing into a bottleneck trade analogous to semiconductors’ “GPU → HBM → networking → power and cooling” progression, with demand moving downstream through “AI models → designs → DNA/proteins → assays → preclinical capacity,” potentially benefiting $TWST, $ILMN, $TXG, GenScript, lab-automation vendors and CROs. $TWST expects triple-digit percentage growth in AI drug-discovery orders in FY26 followed by another year of triple-digit growth in FY27; GenScript’s AIDD business doubled year over year in 1H26, while channel checks indicate throughput of roughly 8,000 designs per day with a path to about 16,000 by year-end 2026. AI-native programs entering human trials and IND-enabling work in 2026–2027 could provide catalysts, animal testing and CRO capacity may become the next bottlenecks, and Phase II and later clinical results in 2028–2030 will determine whether the long-term thesis holds.
summary_i18n.zh: AI药物发现正在形成类似半导体“GPU→HBM→网络→电力与冷却”的瓶颈交易，需求沿“AI模型→设计→DNA/蛋白→检测→临床前产能”向下游传导，$TWST、$ILMN、$TXG、GenScript、实验室自动化厂商和CRO有望受益。$TWST预计FY26的AI药物发现订单实现三位数百分比增长，FY27再度实现三位数增长；GenScript的AIDD业务在2026年上半年同比翻倍，渠道检查显示其处理能力约为每日8,000个设计，并可能在2026年底达到约16,000个。2026至2027年AI原生项目进入人体试验及IND申报准备可能成为催化，动物实验与CRO产能或成为下一瓶颈，而2028至2030年的II期及后续临床结果将决定长期逻辑能否成立。

summary_i18n.en: LITE raised its projected optical supply shortfall from roughly 30% to 70%, implying that supply could meet only about 30% of customer demand once CPO and NPO adoption accelerates in 2027; customer allocations are already necessary, and supply-demand balance may not return until 2029 or 2030. Key tickers: $LITE, $COHR, $AAOI
